subject: Observability onboarding — SkyForge activation decision log
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Soto <clara.soto@skyforge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Observability onboarding — SkyForge activation decision log

Hi Clara and team,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. As promised, I put together an initial decision log and a lightweight runbook template to accelerate the first integration sprint. Attached: decision_log_v0.1.xlsx and redwood_runbook_template.md. Also attaching a short dashboard_panel_spec.pdf with the fields we typically need for a minimal go-live view.

Key decisions we should confirm this week so we can lock the implementation backlog:
- Alert routing: SRE alert -> PagerDuty, CS high-priority -> Slack ops-channel, Product -> email digest (daily).
- Tracing hooks: instrument service entry/exit + external downstream call tagging; 99th percentile spans to be retained for 72 hours.
- Error taxonomy: fold client-side retries into "retryable" category and bubble persistent 5xx to "service_failure".
- Dashboards: 4 core panels (latency P50/P95/P99, error rate %, active requests, KV-cache hit ratio).

Please review the attached decision_log and add any items you want included in the matrix. If this aligns, propose we schedule a 45 minute implementation planning call with your platform and our CS/infra leads on Monday.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Clara: confirm alert routing channels and stakeholders.
2) SkyForge devs: add one sample trace (zipkin/OTEL) to shared Drive folder.
3) Redwood: prepare sprint ticket breakdown and initial dashboard JSON.

Thanks,

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Clara Soto <clara.soto@skyforge.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Team <platform@skyforge.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding — SkyForge activation decision log

Markus — thanks, this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Alert routing: we use Opsgenie for SRE alerts today; can Redwood integrate with Opsgenie or should we route via PagerDuty as a destination?
- Tracing retention: 72 hours is fine for now; can we request a policy to export aggregated traces to our S3 bucket weekly?
- Dashboards: the four panels look good but we also want a "service dependency map" panel to help runbooks during incidents.

Attaching a sample OTEL trace from our staging environment to the Drive folder now (link: https://drive.google.com/sample-trace-skyforge).

Also, small ask on runbook: please include a short play for DB failover detection — our DB team needs that explicitly called out.

Happy to do the Monday call — our preference is 10:00–11:00 PDT.

Best,
Clara
Clara Soto
Head of Platform, SkyForge

Quick internal note — seeing Clara's mention of Opsgenie. We can integrate Opsgenie as a webhook target (we've done that for two customers recently). If Opsgenie is the primary SRE route, we should set the alert dedup window to 3m and have a separate high-priority rule that also forks to the CS Slack channel for P1s.

On retention/export: I'll raise a ticket with infra to add an export job to S3 (weekly aggregates) and confirm permissions model (principle of least privilege).

Also +1 to adding DB failover play to the runbook. I can draft the escalation steps and checks.

—Ben

Clara / team — technical confirmation from infra side:

- Opsgenie: we will add an Opsgenie webhook destination. Please share the service key; we'll lock it down to the SkyForge org.
- Tracing hooks: we'll provide a small snippet (OTEL auto-instrumentation guidance) and a sample middleware for request ID propagation; expectation is minimal code changes for your services.
- Dashboard panels: I'll populate the dashboard JSON and add a dependency map panel using the service map from the trace samples you dropped.
- Runbook: Ben and I will co-author the DB failover play, and I'll add a short verification checklist so CS can confirm during incident drills.

I've added a draft dashboard JSON to the shared Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSkyForgeObs (file: dashboard_skyforge_initial.json).

Laura

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Soto <clara.soto@skyforge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Observability onboarding — decisions and next steps (summary)

Clara — thanks for the quick responses and for dropping the trace. Summarizing decisions and owners so we’re all aligned: 

Decisions confirmed:
- Alert routing: Opsgenie is primary for SRE (SkyForge will share service key). For P1s we will fork to CS Slack as a parallel notify. (Owner: Ben)
- Tracing retention/export: 72h hot retention; weekly aggregated export to SkyForge S3. (Owner: Ben / Infra)
- Dashboard: 4 core panels + dependency map panel based on trace map. (Owner: Laura)
- Runbook: DB failover play will be added with a verification checklist. (Owners: Ben + Laura)

Attachments: decision_log_v0.1.xlsx (updated with owners), redwood_runbook_template.md, dashboard_panel_spec.pdf. I updated the decision log with the owners and tentative due dates (see the attached spreadsheet).

Next steps (this week):
- SkyForge: share Opsgenie service key and confirm Monday 10:00–10:45 PDT for the planning call.
- Redwood: post sprint ticket breakdown and invite the SkyForge engineers to the planning call.
- All: add any missing items to the decision_log spreadsheet by EOD Monday.

If that captures it, I’ll schedule the call for Monday at 10:00 PDT and send the calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into sprint.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
